title: Near Future — Ir + Infinitive
module: Módulo 4 — Planos, capacidade e ações em andamento

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “Your plans for the next weekend” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Use conjugated ir + infinitive for a future plan.
student.english_comparison: English going to also uses an auxiliary; Portuguese infinitive stays unchanged.

model_sentences.en: I am going to travel tomorrow.
We are going to study at night.
She is going to work later.
They are going to eat at home.
Are you going to read today?

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “I am going to travel tomorrow.”?
Which sentence expresses “We are going to study at night.”?
Which sentence expresses “She is going to work later.”?
Which sentence expresses “They are going to eat at home.”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

items.hint: I am going to travel tomorrow.
We are going to study at night.
She is going to work later.
They are going to eat at home.

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: Amanhã eu vou estudar português. Minha amiga vai trabalhar de manhã. Nós vamos almoçar juntos depois. No sábado, eles vão visitar a família. Você vai viajar no fim de semana? Eu não vou viajar; vou descansar em casa.
questions: O que a amiga vai fazer de manhã?
O narrador vai viajar no fim de semana?
O que você vai fazer amanhã?

review.another_way_to_understand_it: Contrast present routine with a planned action.

examples.en: They are going to eat at home.
Are you going to read today?
I am going to talk to her.

review.compare: Eu estudo hoje / Vou estudar amanhã: habit or present versus plan.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

items.cue: They are going to eat at home.
Are you going to read today?
I am going to talk to her.

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.
items: She is going to work later.
They are going to eat at home.
Are you going to read today?

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

items.sentence: Eles vão comer em casa. Ela ________ trabalhar depois.
items.hint: She is going to work later.

items.sentence: Você vai ler hoje? Eles ________ comer em casa.
items.hint: They are going to eat at home.

items.sentence: Eu vou falar com ela. Você ________ ler hoje?
items.hint: Are you going to read today?

items.sentence: Eu vou viajar amanhã. Eu ________ falar com ela.
items.hint: I am going to talk to her.

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: Hoje eu trabalho em casa. Amanhã vou trabalhar no escritório. Ana vai estudar à noite. Nós vamos comprar livros na sexta-feira. No domingo, os amigos vão caminhar no parque. Você vai estudar amanhã?
questions: Onde o narrador vai trabalhar amanhã?
O que os amigos vão fazer no domingo?

speaking_practice.instruction: Answer in order: factual answers first, then personal examples and explanations. All answers are spoken in full sentences.

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Which sentence expresses “I am going to travel tomorrow.”? A. Eu vou falar com ela. B. Nós vamos estudar à noite. C. Eu vou viajar amanhã.
A_multiple_choice.worked_answer: C. Eu vou viajar amanhã. — compare the exact meaning, then read it aloud.

B_gap_fill.instruction: Eu ________ viajar amanhã. (I am going to travel tomorrow.)
B_gap_fill.worked_answer: vou → Eu vou viajar amanhã. — use the English hint and the rest of the sentence.

C_english_to_portuguese.instruction: She is going to work later.
C_english_to_portuguese.worked_answer: Ela vai trabalhar depois. — identify the subject, choose the verb form, then say it.

D_portuguese_to_english.worked_answer: I am going to travel tomorrow. — translate the meaning, not word for word.

E_reading_comprehension.instruction: O que a amiga vai fazer de manhã?
E_reading_comprehension.worked_answer: Ela vai trabalhar. — find the sentence in the text that gives the answer, then answer in a full sentence.

F_written_production.instruction: Write one new sentence with the target form, using “Eles vão comer em casa.” as a reference.
F_written_production.worked_answer: Model: Você vai ler hoje? — change the information, keep the target structure correct.

G_speaking.instruction: Say one sentence with today’s structure about your own life.
G_speaking.worked_answer: Model: Eu vou falar com ela. — say it, then change one real-life detail.

F_written_production.instruction: Write 6–8 sentences on the topic “Your plans for the next weekend”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — O que você vai fazer amanhã? / Você vai viajar no sábado? / Quando vocês vão almoçar? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

teacher.pronunciation_focus: Separate sounds in vou estudar but keep natural rhythm.

F_written_production.assessment: Check length, topic relevance, at least three accurate uses of the target structure, and agreement. Personal details vary.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
